source_scope: Round 69: printed Chapters 1102–1111. Chapter titles and primary text checked on Bq8xsw; relevant continuations and receipts checked independently on Bqquge. Vietnamese translation catalogs were searched across multiple sites but did not expose reliably aligned chapter text for this range.

confirmed_outcomes.event: No new itemized or quantified receipt; the chapter advances the phase-one aftermath and directs retrieval of pooled spoils.

Day 14 pooled battle spoils received: 27,920,000 Ice Dragon Marks, 14,150,000 Glacier Fragments, 361 Ice Dragon Crystals, and 247 unknown frostland rune stones; following receipt text is elided. Phase-one victory grants each survivor a 5,000,000-mark Dragon Shop redemption quota, the Continent Defender title, +20% all attributes during the Dragon War, and one lord-only revival.

Dragon market lists Legendary Icefield Giant Rhino meat and Demi-god Blood Whale meat. Sale proceeds are 11,200,000,000 Ice Dragon Marks and 1,980 Legendary Ancient Planks (portion mix unspecified). Redeems the globally unique 10,000,000,000-mark upper-god Ice Core.

Purchases 20 expert, 10 master and 2 legendary proficiency emblems plus two choice relic boxes for 260,000,000 marks; boxes yield Snake God Remnant and Ancient Ivory. Purchases 40 tier-10 boss Dragonblood Warrior scrolls and 3 legendary commander scrolls for 1,400,000,000 marks; all 43 are used.
Previously acquired relics cause legendary-heart breakouts; no second acquisition.
Previously acquired proficiency emblems are distributed; no second acquisition.
Dragon Soul Envoy NPC arrives and offers trials and hidden shop access; no reward receipt.

Sells 1,500,000 rhino meat portions for 7,500,000,000 marks. Hidden shop sells 5 dragon-language spell scrolls (2 Natural Dragon, 2 Dark Flame Dragon, 1 Star Dragon) for 7,500,000,000 marks. Other listed stock remains offers only.
Explains effects of five already purchased spell scrolls; no consumption or additional acquisition.

Phase II rules: Eternal Disaster Nests spawn monsters; nest destruction grants 1,000,000 score, 1,000,000 marks, 1 Gold Point and 100 reputation each; divine-level Ice Nest monster kill grants 10,000,000 score, one Doomah Frostblood Crystal and 10 Gold Points. No nest or divine monster is killed in the chapter.

unresolved_conflicts: Vietnamese catalogs for Cơm Nguội Novel and Bách Ngọc Sách did not expose chapter text aligned to printed Chapters 1102–1111. Cơm Nguội's browser view exposed only its page shell/footer, while Bách Ngọc Sách uses split-segment numbering that cannot be safely mapped from catalog counts. Vietnamese search results were used to locate these catalogs, not to assert extraction facts.
The Day 14 pooled receipt in Ch1103 is visibly elided after the four named and quantified items; no quantities were inferred for omitted lines.
Ch1104 gives aggregate market-sale proceeds but does not state how many portions were sold through currency versus ancient-plank barter.
Ch1109's hidden shop shows multiple global stock offers; only the five explicitly purchased dragon spell scrolls are recorded as acquired.
non_receipts: Ch1102 gives no new counted receipt; prior balances and costs are not new acquisition.
Ch1103's 5,000,000-mark phase-one reward is redemption quota, not Ice Dragon Marks deposited. Title, temporary attribute buff and lord-only revival are event rewards/effects, not item inventory.
Ch1104 shop menu rows are offer terms; market stock is not assumed sold. The upper-god Ice Core is recorded as acquired only because redemption is explicit.
Ch1105 relic boxes and recruitment scrolls are immediately opened/used; downstream effects in Ch1106–1107 do not duplicate their acquisition.
Ch1108 NPC/shop availability is not an item or reward receipt.
Ch1110 describes the five owned scrolls without showing use.
Ch1111 reward amounts are repeatable event rules, not actual receipts. Doomah Frostblood Crystal is distinct from Ice Dragon Crystal.
